text:
morgan: planning to roll the toggle orchestration change tonight during the 23:00 UTC window. aiming for gradual ramp + per-region holdouts. who can own smoke checks?

eva: 23:00 UTC ok for me. i can own the first 20min of smoke and metric checks. will be remote available for 2h after.

leo: i can monitor infra and routing. i'll watch the per-region traffic pins and check p95. will alert if any spike.

jia: quick preflight: ensure config-service has the new key `orchestration.enable_v2` set to `off` as safe default, then flip to `on` in steps. Also confirm the fallback route `model-legacy` is healthy.

morgan: yup safe default is `off`. plan: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~30m with 10m observation windows. rollback trigger: error rate > 0.5% for 2 consecutive windows or p95 latency +30%.

sam: oncall noted. i've added a paging policy: if rollback happens, page infra-sre -> eng-platform -> oncall. please include exact rollback command in the thread.

morgan: rollback command (one-liner):
```
configctl set --service inference --key orchestration.enable_v2 --value false --env prod && ./ops/run-traffic-pin --all-regions --pin model-legacy
```
use that in a terminal on bastion A (ops role).

devops-bot: scheduled: feature-toggle-orchestration at 1956789012 -> scheduled for 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. owners: morgan,eva. ETA window: 23:00-01:00 UTC.

claire: quick product check: are there safe defaults for outputs? if new path fails we should still return structured response matching current schema. we can't return raw error blobs.

jia: yes we'll gate the new executor behind response-compat middleware. if any schema diff is detected we'll auto-fallback to legacy path and flag sample for investigation.

eva: smoke checklist i'll run after flip:
- sanity: 10 quick inference calls across regions (curl + compare hash)
- perf: check p50/p95 tokens/sec vs baseline
- correctness: run 5 golden prompts in smoke script
- logs: confirm no new WARN > 10/min in inference logs

morgan: eva can you paste the smoke command you'll run?

eva: smoke script:
```
./smoke.sh --env prod --routes /v1/generate,/v1/chat --golden smoke/golden_prompts.json --concurrency 5
# example curl check
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .response | head -n1
```

morgan: perfect. can someone quick-approve the PR that toggles the orchestration flag rollout policy? (#4892)

leo: reviewed and left minor nits. approving now. please squash the debug logs as requested.

sam: i've created an incident-runbook stub labeled "orchestration-toggle-rollback" and set it to private. link: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/orchestration-toggle-rollback

morgan: thanks everyone. final checklist: deploy at 23:00 UTC, eva smoke owner, leo infra monitor, sam oncall. i'll post status updates in this thread every window. :thumbsup:

eva: noted, will post results after each stage.

leo: i'll open a temp dashboard (p95 / errors / qps) and share link once live.

morgan: if no objections, proceeding as planned. otherwise speak now.

claire: go for it, will watch metrics from product side.

morgan: rolling in 5h — will ping when starting stage 0.
